actions.reason: The K4_C0001|K4_C0004 boundary is merge-compatible based on union eigengap analysis showing dominant single-cluster resolution at candidate_k=1 (0.492 vs 0.334 at k=2), which per evidence rules must not be interpreted as supporting two separate units (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:aad94ea7bd). Native-modality boundary representation is actively contradicted by CT geometry (negative silhouette -0.027, 59.6% negative fraction) with only weak support from RNA and WSI, despite stronger WXS separation (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:aad94ea7bd). Although both sets have interpretable transcriptomic phenotypes—K4_C0001 showing immune/metabolic downregulation (ER:d2497140466c:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:e5313ac502) and K4_C0004 showing structural/cell-cycle upregulation with metabolic suppression (ER:d2497140466c:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:6e0bda1ea1)—biological differences do not mechanically prohibit merge when structural evidence supports a single unit. The combination of merge-compatible union structure and cross-modally conflicting boundary representation supports provisional merger.

actions.reason: K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004 has interpretable biology (VHL/PBRM1-enriched, BAP1-depleted mutational profile and immune-cold/mesenchymal transcriptomic phenotype; ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:2e98e40a49, ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:2e98e40a49), but its membership is broadly unsupported across native modalities. CT geometry shows a negative mean silhouette (-0.031) with 63.5% of patients closer to competing sets, RNA is weakly positive (0.016), WSI moderate (0.096), and only WXS provides strong support (0.213) (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:2e98e40a49). Both decision-relevant boundaries are structurally merge-compatible: the union eigengap for K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004|K4_C0002 is dominated by k=1 (0.434 vs 0.172 at k=2) with high normalized cut (0.533) (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:fb19a1c30f), and K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004|K4_C0003 similarly shows single-cluster dominance (k=1 gap 0.431) with low ARI (0.366) and high normalized cut (0.540) (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:af5083835c). Boundary representation in native geometries is conflicting, with three modalities showing near-zero silhouettes and >30% negative fractions against K4_C0002 (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:fb19a1c30f). Additionally, membership is significantly associated with tissue source site, CT contrast phase, and CT manufacturer (ER:c5a58e927fd7:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:2e98e40a49), providing plausible technical alternatives. No feasible split is supported (screen_candidate_k=1; ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:set:2e98e40a49). Strong biology cannot rescue a candidate whose membership is broadly unsupported and whose relevant boundaries are merge-compatible.

K4_C0002 exhibits a highly coherent biological identity defined by strong metabolic transcriptomic upregulation (oxidative phosphorylation NES 2.79, fatty acid metabolism NES 2.21, mTORC1 NES 1.94; ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:fc5a03698e) and profound VHL-wild-type mutational depletion (VHL OR=0.023, q=2.33e-07; ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:fc5a03698e). Although native-modality membership representation is broadly discordant (negative silhouettes in RNA, WSI, WXS; ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:fc5a03698e) and extensive technical confounding exists (site, CT manufacturer, scanner model, kernel, slice thickness, z-spacing all significant; ER:c5a58e927fd7:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:fc5a03698e), the critical boundary to K4_C0003 is structurally well-supported. The K4_C0002|K4_C0003 union eigengap is dominated by k=2 (0.487 vs 0.052 at k=3), indicating the consensus geometry supports two clusters rather than a single unit, with high independent spectral ARI (0.846) and clear within-versus-between affinity contrast (0.570 vs 0.193) (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:901823f7b2). This structural independence from its nearest neighbor, combined with the distinct and coherent VHL-wildtype/metabolic biology, supports retention as an independent discovery-stage unit despite cross-modal membership discordance and technical associations. No feasible internal subdivision is supported (screen_candidate_k=1; ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:set:fc5a03698e).

K4_C0003 has a highly coherent and distinctive biological identity characterized by extreme BAP1 mutation enrichment (OR=26.67, q=0.0059, 50% of members; ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:42fb02ccf5) and strong immune-inflammatory transcriptomic upregulation (allograft rejection NES 2.82, IFN-gamma NES 2.41, IL-6/JAK/STAT3 NES 2.33; ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:42fb02ccf5). Membership representation is mixed but RNA geometry provides the strongest and most coherent native support among all candidates (silhouette 0.133, 10% negative fraction; ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:42fb02ccf5). The boundary to K4_C0002 is structurally well-supported in the consensus geometry, with union eigengap dominated by k=2 (0.487), high spectral ARI (0.846), and clear affinity contrast (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:901823f7b2). While the boundary to K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004 is merge-compatible in consensus structure (k=1 dominant, low ARI 0.366; ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:af5083835c), K4_C0003 remains independently represented against K4_C0002, which is the more structurally challenging neighbor given their higher between-set affinity (0.193; ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:partition:e3b0c44298). Technical confounding with site and CT spacing parameters exists (ER:c5a58e927fd7:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:42fb02ccf5) but does not override the combination of distinctive BAP1-mutant/immune-hot biology and structural independence from K4_C0002. No feasible internal subdivision is supported (screen_candidate_k=1; ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:set:42fb02ccf5).
